## Professional profile

Ariel Oscar Pironti is an Engineering Manager and Software Architect with 14+ years of professional software engineering experience. His background combines hands-on .NET and backend engineering, distributed systems, software architecture, engineering leadership, DevOps, platform modernization and agentic AI systems.

Current professional focus includes engineering management, architecture governance, cross-functional team leadership, technical strategy, CI/CD, reliability, observability, incident management, legacy modernization and AI-assisted software engineering.

## Agentic AI Engineering

Areas of practical work and research include:

- Agentic AI systems.
- Multi-agent software engineering workflows.
- Specialized analyst, builder and validator agent roles.

- Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Context engineering.
- Long-term memory for software agents.

- Agent governance and controlled-write workflows.

- AI-assisted software engineering.
